en: A cat in love, peering out from behind the wild asters.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Tagawa Hōrō
jp: 京の夜にしてはさわがし猫の恋
romaji: Kyō no yo ni / shite wa sawagashi / neko no koi
en: Noisy, for a night in Kyoto: cats in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 妻乞や一角とれしのらの猫
romaji: Tsuma-goi ya / hito kado toreshi / nora no neko
en: Calling for a mate, the stray has turned into a cat of some standing.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫も妻かせぎする夜也けり
romaji: Nora neko mo / tsuma kasegi suru / yo nari keri
en: A night when even the stray goes out to earn himself a wife.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 山猫も恋は致すや門のぞき
romaji: Yama neko mo / koi wa itasu ya / kado nozoki
en: The wildcat too does his courting, peering in at the gate.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 山猫や恋から直に里馴るる
romaji: Yama neko ya / koi kara sugu ni / sato naruru
en: The wildcat: one love affair, and he is a village cat at once.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 桃の門猫を秤にかける也
romaji: Momo no kado / neko wo hakari ni / kakeru nari
en: At the gate among the peach trees, someone is weighing the cat on the scales.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫も妻乞ふ声は持にけり
romaji: Nora neko mo / tsuma kou koe wa / mochi ni keri
en: Even a stray owns a voice for calling to his love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 正月や猫の塚にも梅の花
romaji: Shōgatsu ya / neko no tsuka ni mo / ume no hana
en: New Year: plum blossoms on the cat’s grave too.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 梅がかにうかれ出けり不精猫
romaji: Ume ga ka ni / ukare ide keri / bushō neko
en: Drawn out by the scent of plum, the lazy cat goes wandering.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 有明や家なし猫も恋を鳴
romaji: Ariake ya / ie nashi neko mo / koi wo naku
en: Moon at dawn: the homeless cat cries out his love as well.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫の源氏めかする垣根哉
romaji: Koi neko no / genji mekasuru / kakine kana
en: The lovesick cat plays Prince Genji along the hedge.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫のうかるる梅が咲にけり
romaji: Nora neko no / ukaruru ume ga / saki ni keri
en: The plum that sets the strays roaming has come into bloom.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の鈴ぼたんのあつちこつち哉
romaji: Neko no rin / botan no atchi / kotchi kana
en: The cat’s bell, now here, now there among the peonies.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 懐の猫も見て居る一葉哉
romaji: Futokoro no / neko mo mite iru / hito ha kana
en: The cat inside my kimono watches it too: one falling leaf.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫の片顔見ゆる小夜砧
romaji: Koi neko no / kata-gao miyuru / sayo-ginuta
en: Half the face of a lovesick cat, in the night, to the sound of the fulling block.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 雪ちるや夜の戸をかく秘蔵猫
romaji: Yuki chiru ya / yo no to wo kaku / hizō neko
en: Snow falling: the pampered cat scratches at the door all night.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: かつしかや猫の逃込むかやのうち
romaji: Katsushika ya / neko no nigekomu / kaya no uchi
en: Katsushika: the cat dives for safety under the mosquito net.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫も宿と定る萩の花
romaji: Nora neko mo / yado to sadamuru / hagi no hana
en: Even the stray has taken them for his lodging: bush clover in flower.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 山里や昔かたぎの猫と萩
romaji: Yama-zato ya / mukashi katagi no / neko to hagi
en: A mountain village: an old-fashioned cat, and bush clover.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 冬の蝿逃せば猫にとられけり
romaji: Fuyu no hae / nigaseba neko ni / torare keri
en: I let the winter fly go, and the cat caught it.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 江戸の猫あわただしさよ角田川
romaji: Edo no neko / awatadashisa yo / sumida-gawa
en: The Edo cat, always in a hurry, by the Sumida River.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 陽炎に何やら猫の寝言哉
romaji: Kagerō ni / nani yara neko no / negoto kana
en: In the heat shimmer the cat mutters something in his sleep.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫なくや中を流るる角田川
romaji: Neko naku ya / naka wo nagaruru / sumida-gawa
en: Cats crying on both banks, and between them flows the Sumida.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 火の上を上手にとぶはうかれ猫
romaji: Hi no ue wo / jōzu ni tobu wa / ukare neko
en: Leaping neatly over the fire: a cat out courting.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: むさしのや只一つ家のうかれ猫
romaji: Musashino ya / tada hitotsu ya no / ukare neko
en: Musashi Plain: the cat of its only house is out courting.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 老猫の蛇とる不承不承哉
romaji: Oi neko no / hebi toru fushō- / bushō kana
en: The old cat catches a snake, without much enthusiasm.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の飯打くらひけりきりぎりす
romaji: Neko no meshi / uchikurai keri / kirigirisu
en: The cricket has gobbled up the cat’s rice.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 年の内に春は来にけり猫の恋
romaji: Toshi no uchi ni / haru wa ki ni keri / neko no koi
en: Spring has arrived before the year is out: cats in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫が仏のひざを枕哉
romaji: Nora neko ga / hotoke no hiza wo / makura kana
en: The stray uses the Buddha’s lap for a pillow.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恥入ってひらたくなるやどろぼ猫
romaji: Haji itte / hirataku naru ya / dorobo neko
en: Ashamed of himself, the thieving cat goes flat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 三日して忘れられぬかのらの猫
romaji: Mikka shite / wasurerarenu ka / nora no neko
en: Three days on, still not forgotten? That stray cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 庵の猫玉の盃そこなきぞ
romaji: Io no neko / tama no sakazuki / soko naki zo
en: My hut’s cat is a jewelled cup with no bottom.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 大猫よはやく行け行け妻が鳴く
romaji: Ō neko yo / hayaku ike ike / tsuma ga naku
en: Big cat, hurry, off you go: your sweetheart is calling.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: なの花にまぶれて来たり猫の恋
romaji: Na no hana ni / mabure kitari / neko no koi
en: Back from love, dusted all over with rape blossom.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 菜の花も猫の通ひぢ吹とぢよ
romaji: Na no hana mo / neko no kayoiji / fukitoji yo
en: Rape blossoms too, blow shut the cat’s way to his love!
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 蝶々や猫と四眠の寺座敷
romaji: Chōchō ya / neko to shimin no / tera zashiki
en: Butterflies: the cat and the silkworms asleep in the temple hall.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫よ見よ見よ蝶のおとなしき
romaji: Nora neko yo / mi yo mi yo chō no / otonashiki
en: Look, stray cat, look how well the butterfly behaves.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫に引つかかれけり梅の花
romaji: Nora neko ni / hikkakare keri / ume no hana
en: Scratched by a stray among the plum blossoms.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 葉がくれの瓜と寝ころぶ子猫哉
romaji: Ha-gakure no / uri to ne-korobu / ko neko kana
en: Under the leaves a kitten lies sprawled beside a melon.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: のら猫が夜永仕事かひたと鳴
romaji: Nora neko ga / yonaga shigoto ka / hita to naku
en: The stray cries without stopping: his work for the long night?
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: しぐるるや迎に出たる庵の猫
romaji: Shigururu ya / mukae ni detaru / io no neko
en: Winter drizzle: my hut’s cat comes out to meet me.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 其次に猫も並ぶや衣配
romaji: Sono tsugi ni / neko mo narabu ya / kinu kubari
en: Next in the line, the cat too, when the New Year clothes are given out.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 安房猫おのがふとんは知にけり
romaji: Ahō neko / ono ga futon wa / shiri ni keri
en: The fool of a cat knows which cushion is his own.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 侘ぬれば猫のふとんをかりにけり
romaji: Wabi nureba / neko no futon wo / kari ni keri
en: Living this poor, I borrow the cat’s cushion.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 陽炎にぐいぐい猫の鼾かな
romaji: Kagerō ni / gui-gui neko no / ibiki kana
en: In the heat shimmer, the cat snoring away, snort after snort.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 陽炎や縁からころり寝ぼけ猫
romaji: Kagerō ya / en kara korori / neboke neko
en: Heat shimmer: off the veranda rolls a half-asleep cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: あまり鳴て石になるなよ猫の恋
romaji: Amari naite / ishi ni naru na yo / neko no koi
en: Don’t cry so much you turn to stone, cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: うかれ猫奇妙に焦れて参りけり
romaji: Ukare neko / kimyō ni jirete / mairi keri
en: The tomcat out courting has come back strangely frantic.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 梅のきず桜のとげや猫の恋
romaji: Ume no kizu / sakura no toge ya / neko no koi
en: Cuts from the plum, thorns from the cherry: cats in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: つりがねのやうな声して猫の恋
romaji: Tsurigane no / yōna koe shite / neko no koi
en: A voice like a temple bell: a cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の恋打切棒に別れけり
romaji: Neko no koi / bukkirabō ni / wakare keri
en: The cats’ affair: they parted without a word.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 我宿の蝿とり猫とうたひけり
romaji: Waga yado no / hae tori neko to / utai keri
en: My house’s fly-catching cat, I said in a poem.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 子を喰ふ猫も見よ見よけしの花
romaji: Ko wo kurau / neko mo mi yo mi yo / keshi no hana
en: Even the cat that eats her young, look, look: poppies in flower.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子のかくれんぼする萩の花
romaji: Neko no ko no / kakurenbo suru / hagi no hana
en: Kittens playing hide-and-seek in the bush clover.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: ぶち猫も一夜寝にけり萩の花
romaji: Buchi neko mo / hito yo ne ni keri / hagi no hana
en: The spotted cat slept a night there too: bush clover.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 綿くりやひょろりと猫の影法師
romaji: Watakuri ya / hyorori to neko no / kagebōshi
en: Cotton ginning: the cat’s shadow, long and wavering.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 陽炎の猫にもたかる歩行神
romaji: Kagerō no / neko ni mo takaru / aruki-gami
en: Heat shimmer: the god of wandering has got into the cat too.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 御影講や泥坊猫も花の陰
romaji: Mieikō ya / dorobō neko mo / hana no kage
en: Founder’s Day: even the thieving cat rests in the shade of blossoms.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 浮かれ猫いけんを聞いて居たりけり
romaji: Ukare neko / iken wo kiite / itari keri
en: The tomcat out courting sat and listened to a lecture.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: うかれ猫狼谷を通りけり
romaji: Ukare neko / ōkami-dani wo / tōri keri
en: The tomcat in love went straight through Wolf Valley.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 嗅で見てよしにする也猫の恋
romaji: Kaide mite / yoshi ni suru nari / neko no koi
en: One sniff, and he gives up: a cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋序よ所の猫とは成にけり
romaji: Koi tsuide / yoso no neko to wa / nari ni keri
en: Off courting, he has become someone else’s cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋ゆへにぬすつと猫と呼れけり
romaji: Koi yue ni / nusutto neko to / yobare keri
en: All for love, and now they call him a thief.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 鼻先に飯粒つけて猫の恋
romaji: Hana saki ni / meshi tsubu tsukete / neko no koi
en: A grain of rice still on his nose, off he goes to love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 我窓は序に鳴や猫の恋
romaji: Waga mado wa / tsuide ni naku ya / neko no koi
en: At my window he cries only in passing: a cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 紅梅にほしておく也洗ひ猫
romaji: Kōbai ni / hoshite oku nari / arai neko
en: Hung out to dry by the red plum: the freshly washed cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: づうづうと猫の寝ころぶ扇哉
romaji: Zū-zū to / neko no ne-korobu / ōgi kana
en: The cat sprawls, bold as you like, on my fan.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 虫干に猫もほされて居たりけり
romaji: Mushiboshi ni / neko mo hosarete / itari keri
en: Airing the summer things, and the cat is being aired as well.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子が蚤すりつける榎かな
romaji: Neko no ko ga / nomi suritsukeru / enoki kana
en: The kitten rubs its fleas off on the hackberry tree.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 我門の猫打栗よ打栗よ
romaji: Waga kado no / neko uchi-guri yo / uchi-guri yo
en: At my gate, chestnuts falling on the cat, falling on the cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 風のおち葉ちよいちよい猫が押へけり
romaji: Kaze no ochiba / choi-choi neko ga / osae keri
en: Leaves in the wind: the cat pins them, one, then another.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子がちよいと押へるおち葉哉
romaji: Neko no ko ga / choi to osaeru / ochiba kana
en: The kitten puts a quick paw on a fallen leaf.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫洗ふざぶざぶ川や春の雨
romaji: Neko arau / zabu-zabu kawa ya / haru no ame
en: Washing the cat, splish-splash in the river: spring rain.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: うかれ猫どの面さげて又来たぞ
romaji: Ukare neko / dono tsura sagete / mata kita zo
en: Tomcat, how dare you show your face here again?
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 鶯や枝に猫は御ひざに
romaji: Uguisu ya / eda ni neko wa / on-hiza ni
en: The warbler on the branch, the cat on my lord’s lap.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子の命日をとぶ小てふ哉
romaji: Neko no ko no / meinichi wo tobu / ko chō kana
en: On the anniversary of the kitten’s death, a little butterfly flits.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 草の戸の菖蒲や猫の手もとどく
romaji: Kusa no to no / ayame ya neko no / te mo todoku
en: Irises at my grass hut, low enough for a cat’s paw to reach.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 大猫のどさりと寝たる団扇哉
romaji: Ōneko no / dosari to netaru / uchiwa kana
en: The big cat flops down to sleep, on top of my fan.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: ぼつぼつと猫迄帰る夜寒哉
romaji: Botsu-botsu to / neko made kaeru / yozamu kana
en: One by one they come home, even the cat: a cold night.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 小夜砧見かねて猫のうかれけり
romaji: Sayo-ginuta / mikanete neko no / ukare keri
en: Fulling blocks in the night: the cat, unable to bear it, goes off courting.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 有明にかこち顔也夫婦猫
romaji: Ariake ni / kakochi kao nari / fūfu neko
en: Moon at dawn: the cat couple look aggrieved.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 庵の猫しやがれ声にてうかれけり
romaji: Io no neko / shagare koe nite / ukare keri
en: My hut’s cat goes courting in a hoarse voice.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: うかれきて鶏追まくる男猫哉
romaji: Ukare kite / tori oimakuru / oneko kana
en: Home from courting, the tomcat chases the chickens all over.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 浄はりの鏡見よ見よ猫の恋
romaji: Jōhari no / kagami mi yo mi yo / neko no koi

author: Kobayashi Issa

source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa

en: The wildcat too creeps in, putting on a voice.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa

en: The parent sparrow chases the cat: give my baby back!
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 山猫のあつけとられし雲雀哉

en: The wildcat left gaping: a skylark.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa

romaji: Neko no ko ga / tama ni toru nari / natsugaki ishi
en: The kitten uses the summer-sutra stone for a ball.

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 笹粽猫が上手にほどく也
romaji: Sasa chimaki / neko ga jōzu ni / hodoku nari
en: The cat unwraps the bamboo-leaf rice cake very neatly.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: よい猫が爪かくす也夏座敷
romaji: Yoi neko ga / tsume kakusu nari / natsu zashiki
en: A good cat keeps its claws in: the summer room.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 阿房猫蠅をとるのが仕事哉
romaji: Ahō neko / hae wo toru no ga / shigoto kana
en: The fool of a cat: catching flies is his job.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: なぐさみに猫がとる也窓の蠅
romaji: Nagusami ni / neko ga toru nari / mado no hae
en: For fun, the cat catches the fly on the window.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 花茨ちよつけいを出す小猫哉
romaji: Hana ibara / chokkai wo dasu / ko neko kana
en: Wild roses: a kitten reaches out a paw to tease them.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子のざれ損ひや芋の露
romaji: Neko no ko no / zare sokonai ya / imo no tsuyu
en: The kitten’s pounce misses: dew on the taro leaf.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の穴から物をかふ寒さ哉
romaji: Neko no ana / kara mono wo kau / samusa kana
en: Buying things through the cat flap: that is how cold it is.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: うら町や大三十日の猫の恋
romaji: Uramachi ya / ōmisoka no / neko no koi
en: A back street: cats in love on New Year’s Eve.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: つぐらから猫が面出すいろり哉
romaji: Tsugura kara / neko ga tsura dasu / irori kana
en: The cat looks out of its straw basket at the hearth.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 膳先の猫にも年をとらせけり
romaji: Zen saki no / neko ni mo toshi wo / torase keri
en: The cat by my tray gets its year older too.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の穴から物買って冬篭り
romaji: Neko no ana / kara mono katte / fuyugomori
en: Shopping through the cat flap: shut in for the winter.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 相ばんに猫も並ぶや薬喰
romaji: Shōban ni / neko mo narabu ya / kusuri-gui
en: The cat lines up too for its share of the winter meat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 一はなに猫がいねつむ座敷哉
romaji: Hito hana ni / neko ga inetsumu / zashiki kana
en: First thing in the New Year, the cat is asleep in the parlour.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 雨の夜や勘当されし猫の恋
romaji: Ame no yo ya / kandō sareshi / neko no koi
en: A rainy night: the cat who has been disowned, in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 浄破利のかがみは見ぬか猫の恋
romaji: Jōhari no / kagami wa minu ka / neko no koi
en: Have you not looked in hell’s mirror of deeds, cat in love?
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 女猫子ゆゑの盗とく逃よ
romaji: Me neko / ko yue no nusumi / toku nige yo
en: Mother cat, stealing for your kittens: run, quick!
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 人中を猫も子故のぬすみ哉
romaji: Hitonaka wo / neko mo ko yue no / nusumi kana
en: Right among people, the cat steals for her kittens.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の飯相伴するや雀の子
romaji: Neko no meshi / shōban suru ya / suzume no ko
en: A baby sparrow shares the cat’s rice.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 摂待や猫がうけとる茶釜番
romaji: Settai ya / neko ga uketoru / chagama-ban
en: Free tea for pilgrims: the cat takes a turn minding the kettle.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 霜の夜や窓かいて鳴く勘当猫
romaji: Shimo no yo ya / mado kaite naku / kandō neko
en: A frosty night: the disowned cat scratching at the window, crying.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 小隅から猫の返しや衣配
romaji: Ko sumi kara / neko no kaeshi ya / kinu kubari
en: From its little corner, the cat’s answer: New Year clothes handed out.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: としの夜や猫にかぶせる鬼の面
romaji: Toshi no yo ya / neko ni kabuseru / oni no men
en: The year’s last night: a demon mask put on the cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 年玉やかたり猫にぞ打つける
romaji: Toshidama ya / katari neko ni zo / uchitsukeru
en: New Year gifts: tossed at the cat who tricked his way in.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 年玉や猫の頭へすでの事
romaji: Toshidama ya / neko no atama e / sude no koto
en: New Year gifts: very nearly landing on the cat’s head.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: ばか猫や年玉入れの箕に眠る
romaji: Baka neko ya / toshidama ire no / mi ni nemuru
en: Silly cat, asleep in the basket for the New Year gifts.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 初夢に猫も不二見る寝やう哉
romaji: Hatsu yume ni / neko mo fuji miru / neyō kana
en: The way it sleeps, the cat too must be dreaming of Fuji on the year’s first night.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 大猫も同坐して寝る雛哉
romaji: Ōneko mo / dōza shite neru / hina kana
en: The big cat sleeps right there among the festival dolls.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 浄破利のかがみそれ見よ猫の恋
romaji: Jōhari no / kagami sore mi yo / neko no koi
en: There, look in hell’s mirror of deeds, cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 垣の梅猫の通ひ路咲とじよ
romaji: Kaki no ume / neko no kayoiji / saki-toji yo
en: Plum by the hedge, bloom so thick you close the cat’s way to his love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 通路も花の上也やまと猫
romaji: Kayoiji mo / hana no ue nari / yamato neko
en: His lover’s path runs over the blossoms: a Japanese cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫が犬の鼻先通りけり
romaji: Koi neko ga / inu no hana saki / tōri keri
en: The lovesick cat walks right past the dog’s nose.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫や口なめづりをして逃る
romaji: Koi neko ya / kuchi namezuri wo / shite nigeru
en: The lovesick cat licks his chops and runs off.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫や答へる声は川むかう
romaji: Koi neko ya / kotaeru koe wa / kawa mukō
en: The lovesick cat: the voice that answers is across the river.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫鳴や塀をへだててあはぬ恋
romaji: Neko naku ya / hei wo hedatete / awanu koi

source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 夜すがらや猫も人目を忍ぶ恋
romaji: Yo-sugara ya / neko mo hitome wo / shinobu koi
en: All night long: the cat too has a love it hides from people.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: なりふりも親そっくりの子猫哉
romaji: Narifuri mo / oya sokkuri no / ko neko kana

source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子の十が十色の毛なみ哉
romaji: Neko no ko no / tō ga to iro no / kenami kana

source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 鶯や猫は縛られながらなく
romaji: Uguisu ya / neko wa shibarare / nagara naku

source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 穴を出る蛇の頭や猫がはる
romaji: Ana wo deru / hebi no atama ya / neko ga haru
en: A snake’s head comes out of its hole, and the cat slaps it.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 梅さくやごまめちらばふ猫の墓
romaji: Ume saku ya / gomame chirabau / neko no haka
en: Plum in bloom: dried sardines scattered on the cat’s grave.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 大猫が尿かくす也花の雪
romaji: Ōneko ga / shito kakusu nari / hana no yuki
en: The big cat covers its pee with a snow of petals.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 塗盆に猫の寝にけり夏座敷
romaji: Nuribon ni / neko no ne ni keri / natsu zashiki
en: The cat asleep on the lacquered tray: the summer room.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 青芝にすり付る也猫の蚤
romaji: Ao shiba ni / suri tsukeru nari / neko no nomi
en: Rubbed off on the green grass: the cat’s fleas.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の狂ひが相応のぼたん哉
romaji: Neko no kurui ga / sōō no / botan kana
en: A peony just right for a cat to go wild in.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の目や氷の下に狂ふ魚
romaji: Neko no me ya / kōri no shita ni / kuruu uo
en: The cat’s eyes on the fish darting under the ice.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 元日や闇いうちから猫の恋
romaji: Ganjitsu ya / kurai uchi kara / neko no koi
en: New Year’s Day: before it is light, cats in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 蝶々を尻尾でなぶる小猫哉
romaji: Chōchō wo / shippo de naburu / ko neko kana
en: A kitten teasing a butterfly with its tail.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 玉棚にどさりとねたりどろぼ猫
romaji: Tama-dana ni / dosari to netari / dorobo neko
en: Flopped asleep on the altar for the dead: the thieving cat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫のとり残しや人のくふいなご
romaji: Neko no tori / nokoshi ya hito no / kuu inago
en: What the cat left over: locusts, for people to eat.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: せま庭の横打栗やどろぼ猫
romaji: Sema niwa no / yoko utsu kuri ya / dorobo neko
en: In the cramped garden, a chestnut swipes the thieving cat side-on.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫塚に正月させるごまめ哉
romaji: Neko tsuka ni / shōgatsu saseru / gomame kana
en: Dried sardines, to give the cat’s grave its New Year.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 鳴く猫に赤ン目をして手まり哉
romaji: Naku neko ni / akanbe wo shite / temari kana
en: Pulling a face at the crying cat, and playing with the New Year ball.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の子にかして遊ばす手まり哉
romaji: Neko no ko ni / kashite asobasu / temari kana
en: The New Year ball, lent to the kitten to play with.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 歯固は猫に勝れて笑ひけり
romaji: Hagatame wa / neko ni katarete / warai keri
en: The New Year’s hard food: the cat wins, and I laugh.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 福俵よい事にして猫ざらる
romaji: Fuku-dawara / yoi koto ni shite / neko zareru
en: The lucky straw bag: the cat takes it as a fine thing to play with.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: よい事に猫がざれけり福俵
romaji: Yoi koto ni / neko ga zare keri / fuku-dawara
en: What luck for the cat: something to play with, the lucky straw bag.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 恋猫のぬからぬ顔でもどりけり
romaji: Koi neko no / nukaranu kao de / modori keri
en: The lovesick cat comes home looking perfectly innocent.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 髭前に飯そよぐ也猫の恋
romaji: Hige saki ni / meshi soyogu nari / neko no koi
en: Rice grains trembling on the tips of his whiskers: a cat in love.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: かい曲り猫が面かく木の芽哉
romaji: Kaimagari / neko ga tsura kaku / ki no me kana
en: Twisting round, the cat scratches its face: buds on the trees.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 紅梅や縁にほしたる洗ひ猫
romaji: Kōbai ya / heri ni hoshitaru / arai neko
en: Red plum: on the veranda edge, the washed cat drying.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 葉がくれの瓜を枕に子猫哉
romaji: Ha-gakure no / uri wo makura ni / ko neko kana
en: Under the leaves, a kitten with a melon for a pillow.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 猫の鈴夜永の菊の咲にけり
romaji: Neko no rin / yonaga no kiku no / saki ni keri
en: The cat’s bell, and through the long night the chrysanthemums have opened.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Kobayashi Issa
jp: 乱れ萩鹿のつもりに寝た猫よ
romaji: Midare hagi / shika no tsumori ni / neta neko yo
en: Tangled bush clover: the cat sleeps in it as if it were a deer.
source: Haiku of Kobayashi Issa (D. G. Lanoue archive)

author: Tsuruta Takuchi
jp: 夜あらしや聞耳たつる猫の妻
romaji: Yoarashi ya / kikimimi tatsuru / neko no tsuma
en: A night storm: the cat in love pricks up his ears.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Tsuruta Takuchi
jp: 五月雨や猫かりに来る船の者
romaji: Samidare ya / neko kari ni kuru / fune no mono
en: Early summer rains: a man off a boat comes to borrow a cat.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Sakurai Baishitsu
jp: 耳うとき婆々はしらずや猫の恋
romaji: Mimi utoki / baba wa shirazu ya / neko no koi
en: Granny, hard of hearing, has no idea: cats in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Inoue Seigetsu
jp: 大切の猫も留守なり朧月
romaji: Taisetsu no / neko mo rusu nari / oborozuki
en: Even my precious cat is out: a hazy moon.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Inoue Seigetsu
jp: 恋すてふ猫の影さす障子かな
romaji: Koisu chō / neko no kage sasu / shōji kana
en: On the paper screen, the shadow of a cat said to be in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Inoue Seigetsu
jp: 猫の戀のびる日あしに追はるゝか
romaji: Neko no koi / nobiru hiashi ni / owaruru ka
en: Cats in love: are they chased along by the lengthening days?
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Naitō Meisetsu
jp: 玉とつてまだ恋知らぬ小猫かな
romaji: Tama totte / mada koi shiranu / koneko kana
en: Grabbing at a ball: a kitten that knows nothing of love yet.
source: Aozora Bunko: 鳴雪句集

author: Naitō Meisetsu
jp: 恋猫や鮑の貝の片思ひ
romaji: Koi neko ya / awabi no kai no / kataomoi
en: A cat in love: one-sided, like an abalone’s single shell.
source: Aozora Bunko: 鳴雪句集

author: Naitō Meisetsu
jp: 猫塚に恋草生ふる小雨かな
romaji: Neko tsuka ni / koigusa ouru / kosame kana
en: On the cat’s grave the grasses of love grow in the light rain.
source: Aozora Bunko: 鳴雪句集

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 犬吼えて遠くなりけり猫の恋
romaji: Inu hoete / tōku nari keri / neko no koi
en: A dog barks, and they move further off: cats in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 晝顔に猫捨てられて泣きにけり
romaji: Hirugao ni / neko suterarete / naki ni keri
en: Among the bindweed, an abandoned cat crying.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 猫のゐてぺんぺん草も食みにけり
romaji: Neko no ite / penpengusa mo / hami ni keri
en: There is a cat, and it is eating even the shepherd’s purse.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 猫の子に胸とゞろかす蟇
romaji: Neko no ko ni / mune todorokasu / hikigaeru
en: The toad’s heart pounding at the sight of a kitten.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 猫の子や親を距離て眠り居る
romaji: Neko no ko ya / oya wo hanarete / nemuri iru
en: A kitten asleep a little way off from its mother.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 石蕗さくや猫の寐こける草の宿
romaji: Tsuwa saku ya / neko no nekokeru / kusa no yado
en: Leopard plants in flower: a cat fast asleep at my grass hut.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Murakami Kijō
jp: 雷や猫かへり来る草の宿
romaji: Kaminari ya / neko kaeri kuru / kusa no yado
en: Thunder: the cat comes home to my grass hut.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Matsuse Seisei
jp: 糸巻を擲たれけり猫の妻

en: Hit with the thread spool: the cat in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Iwaya Sazanami
jp: 露霜の籬に猫の捨られし
romaji: Tsuyujimo no / magaki ni neko no / suterareshi
en: A cat abandoned by the frosty fence.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Terada Torahiko
jp: 冰る夜や顔に寄り来る猫の鬚
romaji: Kōru yo ya / kao ni yorikuru / neko no hige
en: A freezing night: the cat’s whiskers come close to my face.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Terada Torahiko
jp: 物言へど猫は答へぬ寒さ哉
romaji: Mono iedo / neko wa kotaenu / samusa kana
en: I speak to it, and the cat doesn’t answer: the cold.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Terada Torahiko
jp: 誰が墓ぞ猫草狗草名なし草
romaji: Ta ga haka zo / nekogusa enokorogusa / nanashigusa
en: Whose grave is this? Cat grass, foxtail grass, grass with no name.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 子供と人形と猫と添寝して
romaji: Kodomo to ningyō to / neko to soine shite
en: Asleep side by side: a child, a doll and a cat.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 夕闇の猫がからだをすりよせる
romaji: Yūyami no / neko ga karada wo / suriyoseru
en: In the dusk a cat rubs itself against me.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 牛がなけば猫もなく遍路宿で
romaji: Ushi ga nakeba / neko mo naku / henro yado de
en: When the cow lows the cat cries too, at the pilgrims’ inn.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 餓えて鳴きよる猫に与へるものがない
romaji: Uete nakiyoru / neko ni ataeru / mono ga nai
en: A hungry cat comes crying, and I have nothing to give it.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 猫はいつもの坐布団の上で
romaji: Neko wa itsumo no / zabuton no ue de
en: The cat, on its usual cushion.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 物思ふ膝の上で寝る猫
romaji: Mono omou / hiza no ue de neru / neko
en: On my lap, as I sit thinking, a cat asleep.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 寝てゐる猫の年とつてゐるかな
romaji: Nete iru neko no / toshi totte iru / kana
en: The sleeping cat: it is getting old.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 猫も鳴いて主人の帰りを待つてゐる
romaji: Neko mo naite / shujin no kaeri wo / matte iru
en: The cat too is crying, waiting for its master to come home.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 人声なつかしがる猫とをり
romaji: Hitogoe natsukashigaru / neko to ori
en: Here with a cat that misses the sound of people.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 猫もいつしよに欠伸するのか
romaji: Neko mo issho ni / akubi suru no ka
en: Are you yawning along with me, cat?
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 猫もさみしうて鳴いてからだすりよせる
romaji: Neko mo samishū te / naite karada / suriyoseru
en: The cat is lonely too: it cries and rubs against me.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: いつ戻つて来たか寝てゐる猫よ
romaji: Itsu modotte kita ka / nete iru / neko yo
en: When did you come back? Sleeping cat.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 話してる間へきて猫がうづくまる
romaji: Hanashiteru aida e / kite neko ga / uzukumaru
en: A cat comes and curls up right between us as we talk.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 別れともない猫がもつれる
romaji: Wakaretomonai / neko ga motsureru
en: Not wanting me to go, the cat winds round my feet.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 師走ゆきこの捨猫が鳴いてゐる
romaji: Shiwasu yuki / kono sute neko ga / naite iru
en: Year’s-end snow: this abandoned cat is crying.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: ゆふべは寒い猫の子鳴いて戻つた
romaji: Yūbe wa samui / neko no ko naite / modotta
en: A cold evening: the kitten came home crying.
source: Aozora Bunko: 四国遍路日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: もう死ぬる声の捨猫をさがす
romaji: Mō shinuru / koe no sute neko wo / sagasu
en: I go looking for the abandoned cat whose voice is dying.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 日向ぼつこする猫も親子
romaji: Hinatabokko suru / neko mo oyako
en: Basking in the sun, the cats too: mother and child.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 恋猫の声も別れか
romaji: Koi neko no / koe mo wakare ka
en: The cry of a cat in love: is it a goodbye too?
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 樹影雲影猫の死骸が流れてきた
romaji: Kokage kumokage / neko no shigai ga / nagarete kita
en: Shadows of trees, shadows of clouds, and a dead cat floating down.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 仔猫みんな貰はれていつた梅雨空
romaji: Koneko minna / morawarete itta / tsuyuzora
en: All the kittens have been given away: rainy-season sky.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 子猫よ腹たてゝ鳴くかよ
romaji: Koneko yo / hara tatete / naku ka yo
en: Little cat, are you crying because you’re cross?
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 子をさがす親猫のいつまで鳴く
romaji: Ko wo sagasu / oya neko no / itsu made naku
en: The mother cat searching for her kittens: how long will she cry?
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 牛小屋のとなりで猫の子うまれた
romaji: Ushigoya no / tonari de neko no ko / umareta
en: Next to the cowshed, kittens have been born.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 恋猫がトタン屋根で暗い音
romaji: Koi neko ga / totan yane de / kurai oto
en: A cat in love on the tin roof: a dark sound.
source: Aozora Bunko: 其中日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: ゆふやみの恋猫のこゑはきこえる
romaji: Yūyami no / koi neko no koe wa / kikoeru
en: In the dusk, the voice of a cat in love can be heard.
source: Aozora Bunko: 其中日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 山里をのぼりきて捨猫二匹
romaji: Yamazato wo / noborikite / sute neko nihiki
en: Climbing up to the mountain village: two abandoned cats.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 捨てられて仔猫が白いの黒いの
romaji: Suterarete / koneko ga shiroi no / kuroi no
en: Abandoned kittens, a white one, a black one.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 野良猫も仔を持つて草の中に
romaji: Nora neko mo / ko wo motte / kusa no naka ni
en: The stray has kittens too, out in the grass.
source: Aozora Bunko: 行乞記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: こんなに晴れた日の猫が捨てられて鳴く
romaji: Konna ni hareta / hi no neko ga / suterarete naku
en: On such a clear day, an abandoned cat crying.
source: Aozora Bunko: 其中日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: ここへも恋猫のきてさわぐか闇夜
romaji: Koko e mo koi neko no / kite sawagu ka / yamiyo
en: Even here the cats in love come and make a racket? A dark night.
source: Aozora Bunko: 其中日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 火の番そこからひきかへせば恋猫
romaji: Hi no ban / soko kara hikikaeseba / koi neko
en: The night watchman turns back from there, and cats in love.
source: Aozora Bunko: 其中日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 街の雑音しづもれば恋猫の月
romaji: Machi no zatsuon / shizumoreba / koi neko no tsuki
en: When the noise of the town dies down, a moon for cats in love.
source: Aozora Bunko: 旅日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 火燵まで入れてもろうて猫がおさきに
romaji: Kotatsu made / irete moroute / neko ga osaki ni
en: They even lit the foot warmer for me, and the cat got in first.
source: Aozora Bunko: 旅日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 大きいのが小さいのが招き猫が春の夜
romaji: Ōkii no ga / chiisai no ga maneki neko ga / haru no yo
en: Big ones, small ones, beckoning cats: a spring night.
source: Aozora Bunko: 旅日記

author: Taneda Santōka
jp: 街のゆうぐれ猫鳴いて逢ひに来た
romaji: Machi no yūgure / neko naite / ai ni kita
en: Dusk in town: a cat came crying, to meet me.
source: Aozora Bunko: 旅日記

author: Ozaki Hōsai
jp: 八ツ手の月夜もある恋猫
romaji: Yatsude no tsukiyo mo aru / koi neko
en: A moonlit night by the fatsia, and a cat in love.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: まだ死なぬ猫秋風に我を凝み視る
romaji: Mada shinanu / neko akikaze ni / ware wo mimiru
en: The cat not dead yet stares at me in the autumn wind.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: 猫の子や今朝又死ちて籠の中
romaji: Neko no ko ya / kesa mata ochite / kago no naka
en: The kittens: this morning another dead, in the basket.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: 子猫見て親猫の居ぬ鳳仙花
romaji: Koneko mite / oya neko no inu / hōsenka
en: I see the kitten, its mother gone: balsam flowers.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: 秋の夜や猫を集めて飯くるゝ
romaji: Aki no yo ya / neko wo atsumete / meshi kururu
en: An autumn night: someone gathers the cats and feeds them.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: 脚をあげて股掻く猫や夏の露
romaji: Ashi wo agete / mata kaku neko ya / natsu no tsuyu
en: Leg in the air, a cat scratching its thigh: summer dew.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Hasegawa Reiyoshi
jp: 若竹に猫の寝てゐる畳かな
romaji: Wakatake ni / neko no nete iru / tatami kana
en: Young bamboo, and a cat asleep on the tatami.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke
jp: つま猫の胸の火や行く潦
romaji: Tsuma neko no / mune no hi ya yuku / niwatazumi
en: The fire in the courting cat’s heart, as he crosses the puddles.
source: Aozora Bunko: 点心

author: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke
jp: かげろふや猫にのまるる水たまり
romaji: Kagerō ya / neko ni nomaruru / mizutamari
en: Heat shimmer: a puddle being drunk by a cat.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke
jp: 餅花を今戸の猫にささげばや
romaji: Mochibana wo / imado no neko ni / sasageba ya
en: I should offer New Year rice-cake blossoms to the Imado cat.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Kawabata Bōsha
jp: 恋猫も蝶も通ひぬ朧の道
romaji: Koi neko mo / chō mo kayoinu / oboro no michi
en: Cats in love and butterflies both pass along the hazy road.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Kawabata Bōsha
jp: 猫の恋月に嘯くとはいへど
romaji: Neko no koi / tsuki ni usobuku / to wa iedo
en: A cat in love: crooning at the moon, one might say.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: うそ寒や障子の穴を覗く猫
romaji: Usozamu ya / shōji no ana wo / nozoku neko
en: A slight chill: a cat peering through a hole in the paper screen.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: 捨て猫の石をかぎ居つ草いきれ
romaji: Sute neko no / ishi wo kagi itsu / kusaikire
en: An abandoned cat sniffing at a stone, in the heat off the grass.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: 草を食む猫の吐気や蚊遣焚く
romaji: Kusa wo hamu / neko no hakike ya / kayari taku
en: A cat eating grass, feeling sick: burning the mosquito smoke.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: 麦秋の猫も人恋ふ産期かな
romaji: Mugiaki no / neko mo hito kou / sanki kana
en: Barley harvest: the cat wants people near, close to giving birth.
source: 575筆まか勢: 猫の恋

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: 我が猫の糞して居るや黍の花
romaji: Waga neko no / fun shite iru ya / kibi no hana
en: My cat doing its business among the millet flowers.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)

author: Tomita Moppo
jp: 猫の草紙さながらの宿や花の昼
romaji: Neko no sōshi / sanagara no yado ya / hana no hiru
en: A house just like the one in the cat storybook: blossom-time afternoon.
source: 575筆まか勢 (saijiki examples)
